activities.title: Listen. Who are the new neighbours? Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Sofia: The new neighbours are here! The dad is tall and has got a short black beard. … Erik: The mum has got long red hair. She's carrying a guitar! … Sofia: A musician! Oliver will be happy… I mean, our friends from Flyers! … Erik: There are two children. The boy is about seven, with glasses like mine. … Sofia: And the girl looks about our age. She has got a football under her arm! … Erik: And look — they have got a small white dog. … Sofia: Luna is already wagging her tail. New friends for everyone!
